claim: For every finite abelian group \(A\) of order \(N\ge3\) and all nonzero \(f,g\in\ell^2(A)\), the normalized short-time Fourier transform \(V_gf\) cannot have exactly \(N+1\) nonzero entries. Since \(|\operatorname{supp}V_gf|\ge N\), its support size is therefore either \(N\) or at least \(N+2\).
integrity: The proof is analytical and self-contained from finite-group Parseval, Cauchy–Schwarz, and subgroup/annihilator facts. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Excludes only the support size \(N+1\); does not classify sizes \(N+2\) and above.
Finite abelian groups only; \(N\ge3\) is required.
The \(N+2\) threshold is not claimed attainable.
title: The one-step support gap for finite-group short-time Fourier transforms
